limits: All errors and upper-depth diagnostics are conditional, not calibrated confidence bounds.
Coarse secondary phase grid; untested phases/durations and eccentric eclipses remain unconstrained.
Phase probes/harmonic variants share photons; no local statistic is a global phase-scan p-value.
Unmodified shifted controls are not guaranteed signal-free null data. Additive paired trials do not calibrate pixel/search completeness.
Fixed shape/ephemeris selected with whole data; morphology, source isolation, independent clocks, reliability and scenario probabilities unresolved.
Harmonic probes use separate event windows and cannot be ranked by summed chi-square or information criteria on differing exposures.
Fourier coefficients are descriptive and have no beaming/reflection/ellipsoidal interpretation or companion exclusion.
